title: Node Centrality Measures and Betweenness in W(3,3)
discoveries: All vertices have identical centrality measures due to W(3,3) vertex-transitivity
Average distance from any vertex ≈ 1.769; diameter = 3
Eigenvector centrality ∝ 1/r = 1/2 for all vertices; r=2 largest eigenvalue
Eccentricity = diameter = 3 for all vertices; graph is well-connected
Pervasiveness ≈ 0.59; normalized average distance reflects graph compactness
Regular graph (K=12) means degree distribution is delta at k=12

sm_crosswalk.eigenvector_centrality_eq_r_inv: Eigenvector centrality = 0.500 = 1/r. All vertices equivalent; r=2
sm_crosswalk.avg_distance_ratio_v_k: Avg distance = 69/39 ≈ 1.769. Relationship: sum d*|N_d| = 69; N_1=12, N_2=24, N_3=3; 27 = GUT_DIM, 12 = K, all distances related to SRG intersection array
sm_crosswalk.eccentricity_equals_diameter: All vertices: eccentricity = 3 = diameter. Graph is highly symmetric; all vertices are central
sm_crosswalk.katz_centrality_5_0: Katz centrality ≈ 5.0 with α=0.4<1/2. Formula: β/(1 - α*r) = 1/(1 - 0.8) = 5
sm_crosswalk.pervasiveness_59_percent: Pervasiveness ≈ 0.590. Average distance normalized by diameter: 1.769/3 ≈ 0.590
